name: Cinder Burrowling
design: A squat red-skinned burrowing demon with a shovel-shaped head, short rear legs and oversized digging foreclaws; three-point low triangular silhouette. No standard horned imp head, sword or shield.

name: Ember Throat
design: A long-necked red-skinned crouching demon caster with an inflated throat pouch and bony chimney-like shoulder crest, casting through its breath instead of a carried staff.

name: Bog Bellower
design: A swollen amphibious carrion creature with a squat torso, tiny submerged-looking hind legs, broad hanging throat and two heavy paddle arms. No human farmworker anatomy or clothes.

name: Shroud Crawler
design: A low sinuous carrion beast with an elongated ribbed body, two forelimbs, dragging tapered rear and a narrow toothless skull partly hidden by burial cloth. No upright zombie silhouette.

name: Needle Mole
design: A blind burrowing beast with a broad digging muzzle, enormous shovel forefeet, tiny hindquarters and a compact quill fan only around the neck; no conventional rat shape.

name: Barbed Skipper
design: A spring-legged ground predator with long reversed hind legs, small grasping forelimbs and a blunt wedge-shaped shell carrying rear-facing spines. No boar or rat silhouette.

name: Root Mauler
design: A huge low quadrupedal furred beast with high bony shoulder arch, blunt tusked head and broad shovel forepaws; no upright ape body or equipment.

name: Hollow Prowler
design: A long-bodied furred cave predator with narrow elevated shoulders, small head, extremely long front limbs and short rear legs; prowling quadruped, no antlers or upright ape.

name: Thorn Widow
design: An adult humanoid-derived corrupted ambush predator with elongated insect-like forearms forming hooked blades, a compact hunched thorax and a veil of torn rogue cloth; no sword, human fighter stance or sexualized features.

name: Sinew Spitter
design: A lean ground predator with folded bow-shaped shoulder arches and a tendon-like projectile launcher between forelimbs; no carried bow and no normal rogue anatomy.

name: Reed Stalker
design: A tall narrow wading predator with long stilt legs, a spear-shaped beak and folded hooked forelimbs, remnants of rogue bindings. No humanoid spearwoman or carried spear.

name: Ossuary Hound
design: A skeletal quadruped assembled coherently around a deep barrel ribcage, heavy flat skull and thick foreleg bones. No humanoid soldier, sword or shield.

name: Rib Harrier
design: A wingless birdlike skeletal runner with long hindlegs, a narrow keel-like ribcage and a forward bone tube for shooting splinters. No human archer or carried bow.

name: Funeral Lantern
design: A hovering skeletal organism: suspended broad ribcage enclosing a small elemental ember, inverted pelvis-like lower cradle and two long jointed forelimbs; no robed humanoid skeleton or staff.

name: Redwing Glider
design: A low gliding carrion creature with broad skin membranes between elongated forelimbs and flanks, short blunt head and hooked rear feet; no conventional raptor body.

name: Gutter Skimmer
design: A six-limbed scavenger with a long neck, narrow leathery forewing pair and four short perching limbs, a blunt shovel beak and sparse feather crest; no standard crow silhouette.

name: Hornback Ravager
design: A low front-heavy horned ungulate predator with four powerful hoofed legs, one broad broken horn and thick matted mane. No humanoid goatman or axe.

name: Hearth Antlerless
design: A hunched cloven-footed ritual creature with a barrel torso, exceptionally long neck, dense wool mantle and two interlocking curved cheek horns; no human arms, staff or deer antlers.

name: Storm Gullet
design: A squat leathery toadlike demon on four elbowed legs with an enormous asymmetrical throat sac and a small recessed head; electrical breath formed within its mouth, no bipedal Tainted silhouette.

name: Crypt Bellows
design: A low arachnid with a broad flattened shield abdomen, tall stiltlike front leg pair and six short rear legs, small recessed head and a web-spinner tail folded underneath; no familiar round-abdomen tarantula silhouette.
